description: Defines a thread-safe, singleton fixed-size memory block pool with thread-local caching and central cache coordination, templated by an ID tag and optional address sanitization.

classes.name: fixed_size_memory_block_pool
classes.description: A thread-safe singleton template class managing fixed-size memory blocks with local thread caches and a central concurrent queue.

methods.name: get_instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the memory pool, optionally initializing with specific number of blocks and block size.

methods.name: allocate_node
methods.description: Allocates a memory block, first trying local cache, then central cache.

methods.name: deallocate_node
methods.description: Returns a memory block to the local cache, rebalance to central cache if local cache is full.

methods.name: print_all_buffers
methods.description: Prints current status of central and local caches.

methods.name: owns_segment
methods.description: Checks if a segment belongs to this pool.

methods.name: init_worker_cache
methods.description: Pre-initializes thread-local cache to avoid overhead during critical paths.
